reason: Most of my leads come from posting and comment-to-DM, and cold DMs are only a side thing when the pipeline is thin, so a tool built around cold outreach fixes a problem I mostly don't have. On about $30k a year, $147 a month is a real bite for something that's a maybe.
objection: My cold DMs aren't the problem, my offer and my content are. A smarter DM sent to more people won't fix that. And there are no customer results at all, 7 seats taken, card up front, and payments final after day 3. I'd be the guinea pig paying $147.
would_change_my_mind: Real results from someone at my level, like booked calls from a few weeks of use, plus a price under about $60 a month or a no-card trial long enough to test it on a thin-pipeline month.
